reading_note: The teaching describes the threefold structure of the regenerating man — celestial (pneumatic), spiritual (psychic), and natural (somatic) — and the daily process by which the Living Soul descends through bodily reception, becomes mingled with the passions of self-love, is then awakened by the Virgin of Light (purity of reception), and is drawn upward through the three discrete degrees back into conjunction with the Indweller (the New Man, the Mind of Light). The arc is daily regeneration: descent into ultimates, separation from what is not the soul's own, and ascent through faith, patience, and charity into the celestial robe.
